text: ねむり　どく　やけど　まひ…　ポケモンの　たいちょうが　わるいと　つかまえ　やすいよ　でも…　かならず　とれる　わけじゃ　ないみたい

structure.jp: ねむり　どく　やけど　まひ…
ポケモンの　たいちょうが　わるいと
structure.en: when a Pokémon's condition is bad

structure.jp: つかまえ　やすいよ
でも…　かならず　とれる　わけじゃ　ないみたい
structure.en: but... it seems it's not that you always get it

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb or い-word means 'whenever that is so, this follows'. わるいと = 'when it is bad'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい stuck onto a verb says the action is easy to do. つかまえ　やすい = 'easy to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜わけではない
patterns.span: とれる　わけじゃ　ない
patterns.explanation: わけではない says 'it's not that...', softly denying what you might assume. じゃ is the casual form of では. かならず　とれる　わけじゃ　ない = 'it's not that you can always get it'.
